title: Add live CLI coverage for capability revocation
summary: Cover `covenant capabilities revoke` through a real daemon and CLI subprocess by granting a capability, parsing the returned signature, revoking it, and confirming the live capability set is empty afterward.
expectedFailureModes: The CLI parses revoke arguments but fails against a live authenticated daemon socket.
The grant output changes and the live revoke test parses the wrong token.
Revocation reports success but leaves the capability visible in the live recent set.
The live test becomes a default CI requirement or depends on non-local services.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd live_cli_capabilities_revoke --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_capabilities_revoke --locked -- --ignored live_
humanEscalation: Approval before making live tests part of default CI
nextAction: Integrated locally; next capability lifecycle slice should cover purge only after retention defaults are decided.
